title: Binary Search | Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Binary search requires a sorted array. It checks the middle element; if the target is smaller, it searches the left half, otherwise the right half, halving the search space each step (O(log n)).

title: Binary Search with Python - w3schools
snippet: The iterative implementation uses low and high pointers, computing mid = (low + high) // 2 each iteration and narrowing the range until the target is found or the range is empty.
